searchText: is the DoS attack described in this post new in any way? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7702-set-eoa-account-code/19923/337 no it’s well known - same issue in 4337 iiuc 4337 mitigates this in the userop mempool by separating validation and execution and imposing a bunch of state access restrictions during validation, while also limiting to 1 userop per account in the mempool. i guess i don't understand why the latter is enough for 7702
